SELECT * FROM departments WHERE is_active = 1 AND id IN (SELECT department_id FROM employees WHERE is_active = 1 AND paid_by = 2 AND id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND MONTH(pay_date) = MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(pay_date) = YEAR(#{payDate})))
AND id IN (SELECT department_id FROM employees WHERE is_active = 1 AND paid_by = 2 AND id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND MONTH(pay_date) = MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(pay_date) = YEAR(#{payDate}))) AND departments.id = #{filter.departmentId} AND id IN (SELECT department_id FROM employees WHERE is_active = 1 AND paid_by = 2)
AND id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND MONTH(pay_date) = MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(pay_date) = YEAR(#{payDate})) AND id IN (SELECT department_id FROM user_departments WHERE user_id = #{userId}) OR (user_apply = 0 AND id IN (SELECT department_id FROM employees WHERE is_active = 1 AND paid_by = 2 AND id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND MONTH(pay_date) = MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(pay_date) = YEAR(#{payDate})))) AND group_id = #{filter.groupId}
ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT *, employee_code AS idCard, gender AS sex, name_en AS fullName, account_id AS accountId, account_number AS accountNumber, (SELECT ordering FROM positions WHERE id = position_id) AS positionOrdering, (SELECT total_amount FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = employees.id AND MONTH(pay_date) = MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(pay_date) = YEAR(#{payDate})) AS totalSalary FROM employees WHERE is_active = 1 AND paid_by = 2 AND department_id = #{departmentId} AND id IN ( SELECT employee_id FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND MONTH(pay_date) = MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(pay_date) = YEAR(#{payDate}) ) AND ( id IN ( SELECT employee_id FROM employee_apply_status AS eas WHERE eas.is_active = 1 AND eas.employee_status_id NOT IN(4,5,6) ) OR id IN ( SELECT employee_id FROM employee_apply_status AS eas WHERE eas.is_active = 1 AND eas.employee_status_id IN (4,5,6) AND MONTH(eas.date) > MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(eas.date) >= YEAR(#{payDate}) ) OR id IN ( SELECT employee_id FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = employees.id AND MONTH(pay_date) = MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(pay_date) = YEAR(#{payDate}) ) ) ORDER BY positionOrdering ASC
